description: This file implements the egl::Config class and related classes/functions for managing graphics surface configurations, including attributes like color formats, buffer sizes, and surface types within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Represents a graphics surface configuration with attributes like color format, buffer sizes, and surface types.

classes.name: ConfigSet
classes.description: Manages a collection of Config objects, allowing addition, retrieval, and filtering based on attributes.

classes.name: ConfigSorter
classes.description: A comparator class used to sort Config objects based on specified attribute preferences.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a Config to the ConfigSet and assigns it a unique ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Config by its ID.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all Configs from the ConfigSet.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of Configs in the set.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific Config pointer exists in the set.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters Configs based on specified attribute criteria and sorts the results.
